correctness.rationale: Every ordered pair of distinct odd primes at most 4919 is scanned (656*655=429680 pairs), and both a trial-division recurrence and sieve-factor memoized recurrence agree on every stopping length. The finite threshold minimum follows because every smaller prime ceiling was examined; unique (4007,4919) witness is explicitly checked. No inference from sampled to infinite parameters is made.

value.rationale: For a prime-Fibonacci trajectory, the smallest possible maximal starting prime required to sustain a chosen number of prime terms is an intrinsic extremal quantity, directly quantifying a previously qualitative assertion of arbitrarily long trajectories. Computing the complete first 22 threshold values and unique first depth-23 extremizer gives sharp reference values for future complexity bounds and recurrences; the result does not rely on claiming a general asymptotic or solving unrelated conjectures.
